issue_title: RabbitMQ consumer enters hot loop on LLM 429 rate limit error
issue_description: When LLM API responds with 429, CPU spikes to 100% and millions of messages are redelivered instantly.
error_log: worker error: rate limit 429 exceeded, immediate nack with requeue=true executed
expected_root_cause: Immediate nack with requeue instead of transitioning run to RETRY_WAIT with delayed outbox event
